title: Surface roughness in microfluidic device fabrication: limitations of conventional methods and a novel solution for multi-material bonding
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19254-19262
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02701B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Christoph Lehmann, Deoraj Singh, Maria Gastearena, Laura M. Comella
A novel bonding method using silicone rubber provides robust bonding for silicones, metals, and epoxies without plasma treatment, overcoming surface roughness challenges for scalable multi-material microfluidic device fabrication.
